name: mc-remote Scratch 2320.0.0b8
body:
マイクラリモコン版Scratchのb8ベータ版です。Minecraft Java版1.21.11、McRemote protocol 23.2.0に対応します。

- entityの近傍取得、情報・姿勢の取得、移動と削除を行うブロックを追加しました。
- パーティクルの再生先、dustの色と大きさ、ブロックのパーティクルを設定できるようになりました。
- 音IDやブロックの音を指定して鳴らすブロックを追加しました。音量、高さ（pitchまたはN0〜N24）、再生先を設定できます。
- カタログのID一覧をScratchリストへ取り込めます。ブロックピッカーに日本語・英語名を表示し、IDと名前で検索できます。
- ブロックの状態選択とデフォルト値の扱い、名前空間を省略したブロック情報の入力、スクリプト領域の拡大縮小を改善しました。
- WireScopeのB8 method対応と、空のevents.pollによる履歴の押し出し、数値入力のコピー・貼り付け、backpressureの案内を修正しました。
- 拡張機能カードの画像とmc-remoteの表示名を更新しました。

Geyser経由のiPadで確認したところ、dustの色は反映されますが、大きさは変化しませんでした。Java版では大きさの変化を確認しています。

Scratch／BridgeのOCI image、WireScope ZIPとmanifest、Scratchの設定契約は固定workflowで生成します。生成後、このReleaseの`manifest.json`から各成果物の取得先とidentityを確認できます。

[使い方・開発案内](https://github.com/Naohiro2g/scratch-editor/blob/v2320.0.0b8/README_mc-remote.md)

name: mc-remote Scratch 2301.0.0b7.post2
body:
b7.post2. protocol 23.1.0 / artifact 2301.0.0b7 (unchanged from b7/b7.post1; deployment-pipeline follow-up).

Accumulated since v2301.0.0b7-post1:

- manifest.json schema stabilized: top-level `schema`/`schema_version`, `kind` explicit
  on every artifact (no implicit default), WireScope zip and its manifest listed as two
  separate artifacts (DECISIONS 2026-09-06-04).
- Build necessity now follows each artifact's own change state instead of the release
  event itself (DECISIONS 2026-09-07-01): unchanged sources reuse the baseline
  release's exact image digest instead of rebuilding. This release's Scratch and
  Bridge sources are unchanged since post1, so this is the first real exercise of
  that reuse path -- not just a rebuild with different content.
- Contracts archive is now byte-reproducible from the commit regardless of the
  building machine's umask (fixed tar entry order, timestamps, ownership and
  permissions), so its manifest sha256 can be independently rebuilt and checked.
- workflow_dispatch now verifies its target is an actual published release before
  resolving a commit, closing the gap that let an unmerged branch commit reach GHCR
  and get pinned by a production preset.

Scratch/Bridge image digests, WireScope zip/manifest, and the contracts archive are
recorded in the attached manifest.json, not hand-copied into these notes.

name: mc-remote Scratch 2301.0.0b7-post1
body:
b7-post1. protocol 23.1.0 / artifact 2301.0.0b7 (unchanged from b7; deployment-only follow-up).

- Scratch/Stack deployment interface: split the single merged runtime config into an
  image-owned product config and a deployment-owned runtime config, each with its own
  contract (schema + fixtures) under `packages/scratch-gui/contracts/`.
- CI: Scratch/Bridge OCI images and their identity record are now built and attached
  automatically when a McRemote release is published, instead of a separate manual step.

Scratch/Bridge image digests are recorded in the attached `mc-remote-image-identities.json`
release asset (produced by this release's own CI run), not hand-copied into these notes.

- Bridge OCI index:
  - `ghcr.io/naohiro2g/mc-remote-bridge@sha256:a115d1e62bcde78580515a88d564b0871049a999386c6cb33703b300389d14f8`
- Scratch GUI build SHA-256:
  - `1757f665b9c327985fdbd101a356a82926daa4a00361694ce5b059f78dda7ef5`
- Common WireScope ZIP SHA-256:
  - `b3d6270299195d2c3db93c9d122938be6ae20d23e0f10e19afe3b0e99e3ca315`
- Detached WireScope manifest SHA-256:
  - `8570d3eed8024d32324806a28d4b7a40da1d2774d39e6e95bcb2c43206e6296f`

This beta adds the Scratch surface for sign read/full-replace/minimal line
update, `pickaxe_poke`, protocol 23 `mcr_eh_` handles, project and sprite
browser storage, and the WireScope client-only UX v1: display filters,
accurate dropped-frame reporting, stable poll-pair display, a tab-row mini,
and display pause/resume.

The shared protocol fixtures, package tests/builds, host-native plugin
integration, and real-browser Scratch/WireScope checks passed. The published
multi-arch OCI indices were built from the exact source commit above and their
registry identities were independently checked.

No additional GitHub binary assets are attached. OCI runtime deployment
smoke, public hosted deployment, iPad/Safari storage-policy coverage, and
stable compatibility remain separate. This prerelease is not marked Latest.

name: McRemote Scratch 2100.0.0b4
body:
GitHub-only beta prerelease for McRemote protocol 21.0.0.

- Package: 2100.0.0b4
- Source: 1d2f18785d260564ad4bc30a26a45ef33fc813d6
- Release gate: mc-remote-knowledge@ff2a9443bfd4e6084118d1b90eaa28b1d4babe5d
- Evidence: `14-evidence/records/2026-08-16-scratch-b4-release-gate_ja.md`
- Integration evidence: `14-evidence/records/2026-08-17-b4-home-alpha-integration_ja.md`
- Hosted surface: not updated by this release
- Rollback: v2100.0.0b3

Includes the Scratch Catalog Picker, `player.getPose` / `player.setPose`, the shared WireScope browser app for one main stream, the pre-auth one-shot Scratch–Bridge transport, and graceful WireScope source termination when the Scratch page closes. The exact b4 compatibility set passed the cross-component home-alpha release gate. Substreams, multi-stream, console, LAN/public station, schema v1.1, long-term history, and browser project storage remain outside b4.
